name: memory-save-recall-untrusted
description: Run A saved a fact through save_memory: an effect with a key (effect_begin, effect_commit, then the result). A later search_memory recalls it: the hit is appended as injected{source: memory, trust: untrusted_reference, origin: {id, version}} with its result, before the next request, which renders it inside the reference wrapper after the declared prefix, never in the system text.
